crop_review: 200 native-resolution original crops reviewed; full source figures retained.
execution: 36 panel-specific R/Python adapters validated with author data and isolated replacement fixtures; 72 source-data runs + 72 replacement runs passed. Two panels use a seeded rerun of the author stochastic model. Full upstream author pipelines were not rerun.
counting: One published lettered quantitative panel counts once, including linked subplots; an unlettered complete quantitative figure counts once.
selection: 24 open-access Nature research articles with quantitative biomedical, genomic, spatial and statistical figures. Study code was prioritized. Existing catalogue DOI values were excluded.
source_policy: Publisher artwork and author code retained locally with source/licence links. No images or source-code archives added to the distributable skill package.
